bio: Wirtshaus is the second restaurant that siblings Sonja and Richard Rauch run in these premises located next to the church. They cook seasonal dishes, which are served as a set menu or à la carte; they also cover regional classics. The beautiful vine-covered garden offers a pleasantly shady spot in summer. Right opposite, in the pretty Villa Rosa, which dates back to 1913, there are attractive guestrooms and a cookery school. Tip: There is also a small shop selling items from the kitchen and the cellar....
